forecast.generalSituationZh: 受偏東氣流影響，明日華南沿岸風勢仍然較大。隨著偏東氣流逐漸緩和，星期四該區天色好轉。預料一股達強風程度的東北季候風會在星期五稍後抵達廣東沿岸，週末期間該區風勢頗大。受隨後乾燥的季候風補充影響，下週初至中期華南天色大致良好，氣溫下降，內陸地區日夜溫差較大。此外，熱帶氣旋煙花會在未來兩三日橫過西北太平洋，隨後逐漸演變為溫帶氣旋。
forecast.generalSituationEn: Under the influence of an easterly airstream, it will still be relatively windy over the coast of southern China tomorrow. With the easterly airstream moderating gradually, the weather will improve over the region on Thursday. A strong northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of Guangdong later on Friday. It will be windy over the region over the weekend. Under the influence of the subsequent dry replenishment of the monsoon, the weather will be mainly fine with temperatures falling over southern China early to midweek next week. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over inland areas. Besides, Tropical Cyclone In-fa will move across the western North Pacific in the next couple of days, then evolve into an extratropical cyclone gradually.
